body: Can you provide more details? What is console output? What version of eslint are you using? Are you using `babel-eslint`?

The first token of the expression should be checked [here](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/8121bed1d8677bad2ba87093c941cc9ea79bdb80/lib/rules/no-extra-parens.js#L204). If it's `{`, it need the parens. Also, somebody seems to have broken [this test](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/8121bed1d8677bad2ba87093c941cc9ea79bdb80/lib/rules/no-extra-parens.js#L235-L237). It should check for `{` or `function`, and there should be no exception for ObjectExpression.

    "env": {
      "node": true,
      "es6": true

**What did you do? Please include the actual source code causing the issue.**
`let test = a => ({ a: 1, b: 2, c: 3 }[a]);`

No errors

Gratuitous parentheses around expression (no-extra-parens)
